svg.title: Masoud Noroozi: medical image processing and deep learning
svg.desc: Banner. Masoud Noroozi, medical image processing and deep learning, Biomedical Engineering, University of Isfahan. A novice student with an ever-curious mind, an aspiring scholar, and an unwavering passion for lifelong learning and discovery. A schematic aortic arch with pulsatile pathlines coloured by speed.
